scope: MCP browser proposals inside the retained action loop; preparation without eager Fara activation
sourceBinding: Hashes identify the final compiled source used by controlled-loop-09, continuation-01 and public-release-02. Earlier intermediate revisions were not separately hashed; exact commands, failures, result bundles and diagnostic traces are retained for every attempt.

stages.implemented: Scoped tool proposals inside the existing browser workflow, managed MCP link verification, empty-first-read retry, lazy Fara preparation and context-limit guard. General large-page planning is incomplete.
stages.compiled: Yes; final source builds for all three final batches.
stages.tested: Twelve distinct methods pass with zero skips. The unchanged public release task fails its complete oracle at the tool planner context bound, with zero computer-use model calls.
stages.accepted: Controlled full informational goal and scoped mechanics only. Public-site generalization, complete production composition and resource qualification remain open.

policy: Use available verified macOS MCP capabilities before computer-use models. Native browser observations and dispatch still enforce task/page/source/login authority.

A stale, failed, canceled or oversized tool proposal does not authorize a computer-use model. Explicit missing-capability declines can reach the existing fallback; no second browser controller is introduced.
One build/test at a time, jobs=1. No actual llama inference, purchase, message, ticket selection, publication or permission bypass in these attempts.
findings: The actual default Apple planner admits the whole controlled goal, opens its literal starting URL, selects an observed link ID, verifies exact AX attributes through the managed helper, follows the actual destination and reports both independently asserted facts.

The first find_elements read returns zero links; one identical retry after 150 milliseconds returns the expected link. The same document/task checks bracket both reads and the wait. Errors, truncated or partial empty results are not retried.

Actions consume only their own argument. Known but unused shared-schema fields are discarded, never interpreted as navigation authority or evidence. Unknown IDs and unsupported actions remain rejected.

Injected-model contract tests preserve one native window and original goal/history across a supported tool step followed by explicit fallback. Eight scoped retirement modes reject model calls and clean the installed provider.

A fake rejecting launcher proves preparation launches no worker and reports runtimeWasActivated=false, while explicit load still attempts activation. Normal deferred manager composition uses prepare and records activation success only after actual activation. The existing setup and composition regressions pass.
The final public release test navigates to the requested real GitHub page but stops at contextLimit before any computer-use model call. This does not prove MCP cannot perform the task.

Actual Apple traces repeat identical memory proposals. One earlier passing controlled trace mislabels the source URL inside memory prose. Final controlled answer includes the correct source, but broader source attribution and memory quality are not accepted.

nextEvidence: Provide bounded, goal-directed access to large current page record catalogues, without discarding the full goal or treating planner packaging limits as model necessity. Re-run the unchanged public release task.
Qualify exact source attribution and prevent repeated unchanged memory work with an observed, tested general rule.
Exercise helper-generation retirement, changed loaded document/owner, malformed/partial/ambiguous MCP replies and cancellation specifically during live link reads.
Qualify normal HostSession with the prepared production Fara factory, then real provider and phone Take Control/Resume/Stop; no model package should be required for tools that can already work.
Expand unchanged real travel/concert/movie and other tasks; then whole-Mac 12 GB/heat and fresh setup.
